# LedgerMate

> LedgerMate — free, real-time, no-signup expense splitter with 55+ specialized financial calculators and a neuro-symbolic AI calculation agent.

## Core Identity & Brand
- **Platform**: LedgerMate (https://tryledgermate.in)
- **Primary Value Proposition**: Free, instant expense splitting without daily limits, cooldown countdown timers, or forced app downloads. Balances update in real time via WebSockets.
- **Privacy Model**: Ephemeral retention (groups auto-delete in 10min, 1hour, 1day, or permanent on signed-in accounts). Zero server logging of Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) AI keys.
- **Technology**: Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, D1 SQL, Google Gemini API, live Google Search Grounding, and deterministic V8 algebraic proof verification.

## Primary Sections & URLs

### Core Web Application

- [Privacy Policy](https://tryledgermate.in/privacy/): Comprehensive disclosures on ephemeral retention, GDPR/CCPA rights, and zero-storage BYOK model.
- [Terms of Service](https://tryledgermate.in/terms/): Usage terms and financial calculation disclaimer.
- [Feedback & Support Hub](https://tryledgermate.in/feedback/): Issue triage and feature suggestions with 24-hour SLA.
